steps: Fresh anonymous Chromium context, viewport 1280x720, open http://127.0.0.1:5173/studio-lab
Drop demo music at 0.35 s, stem at 2 s, sfx at 4 s (snap off); click the music clip, press Ctrl+D twice (5M project)
Open Export, choose WAV or MP3, click the export button
While exportState is rendering, measure the dialog panel (.max-h-[90vh].overflow-auto) and [data-testid=arrangement-export-progress] / -progress-label
bugs.expected: The stage's new progress label and <progress> bar are visible inside the Export dialog during every export, without the user having to scroll, at both required viewports (1440x900 and 1280x720).
bugs.actual: At 1280x720 the panel is 36-684 px (clientHeight 646, scrollHeight 758 during render, scrollTop 0). The label sits at 677-693 px (cut off), the bar at 709-717 px (fully below the panel fold) and the busy 'მიმდინარეობს…' button at 740-778 px (hidden). Wheel-scrolling the panel by 200 px (scrollTop 112) brings the bar into view (597-605 px), so it can be reached, but nothing scrolls it into view by default. At 1440x900 the label, bar and button are all visible (bar 743-751 inside panel 70-830). Context: at 971141d the 1280 panel already overflowed by 12 px before any export (658 vs 646); the new label and bar add about 100 px. Severity is medium: progress is the stage's main user-visible deliverable, and 1280 is a required viewport. Data and export are unaffected. Measured on the 5M project only; the layout is not expected to depend on project length (not separately measured).
